slot.brief: Mixed alpha-numeric series where each term has a letter block and a number block following separate rules; find the next (or missing) term.

stem: Find the next term in the following alphanumeric series: D7Y, H10V, L15S, P22P, ____

verdicts.working: First letters advance by 4 (D, H, L, P, T); last letters retreat by 3 (Y, V, S, P, M). Middle numbers increase by consecutive odd numbers (+3, +5, +7, +9), giving 31.

working:
First letters advance by 4: D, H, L, P, T. Numbers increase by 3, 5, 7, then 9: 7, 10, 15, 22, 31. Final letters move back by 3: Y, V, S, P, M. Hence T31M. The other options alter one component.
